description: Defines a template class QuicheCircularDeque, a circular buffer container similar to std::deque optimized for stable size scenarios, with iterator support and internal memory management.

classes.name: QuicheCircularDeque
classes.description: A circular deque container optimized for stable size operations, with custom iterator support and internal memory management.

classes.name: basic_iterator
classes.description: An internal iterator class supporting random access iteration over QuicheCircularDeque elements.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the deque.

methods.name: push_front
methods.description: Adds an element to the front of the deque.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the deque.

methods.name: pop_front
methods.description: Removes the first element from the deque.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the deque to a specified size, optionally filling new elements with a value.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for at least the specified number of elements.
